newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTUGAL SECURE NEEDED WIN AGAINST UKRAINE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTUGAL SECURE NEEDED WIN AGAINST UKRAINE.

text.p: Portugal beat Ukraine 1-0 on Saturday to secure the win they desperately needed to keep alive their chances of qualifying for the World Cup finals in France.
Their victory took them to the top of qualifying group nine but they have played more games than Ukraine or Germany, their main challengers in the group.
Defender Fernando Couto scored in the 58th minute with a fierce drive from close range after a mistake by the Ukrainian defence.
The Ukrainians, who beat Portugal 2-1 at home last month, had clearly come to defend and it was not until the Portuguese went ahead that they made any real attempt to attack.
But the visitors lacked the pace to trouble a rock-solid Portuguese defence and Portugal's 'keeper Vitor Baia was a virtual spectator for most of the match.
Benfica striker Joao Vieira Pinto could have given the Portuguese a second after he turned brilliantly in the box but his well-struck shot flew just wide.
